evidence_scope: Frozen confirmation template. The selected adapter and CA-OPEX versions were not run or tuned on the 50-episode 39300/49300 block; base seeds 1/10 were predeclared rather than performance-screened. External baseline arms on these episode seeds already existed and all such raw records are retained, so the whole evaluation block is not described as blind. The template remains unusable until final implementation SHA256 placeholders are resolved before any predeclared adapter training directory or OPEX confirmation output exists.
